reason: A client-side web plugin that adds a right-side conversation node navigator with message previews, scrolling, active-position tracking, and recent input history.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中提供对话节点导航、消息预览、定位高亮和输入历史回填功能。
summaries.en: Adds conversation node navigation, message previews, position tracking, and input-history recall to the DSH Web GUI.

capabilities: reads current conversation user messages from the session log
adds a conversation navigation panel to the web interface
scrolls to and highlights selected messages
reads and updates draft input history through the chat composer
